care: Protect young plants from heavy browsing. SANBI reports warm rocky and semi-arid habitats; ground-level goat browsing can prevent vegetative spread and reduce regeneration.
purchase: Ask for correctly identified spekboom and record whether it is planted for food, browse or restoration. No measured household leaf yield is supplied.
